how: UI stage 1 golden of the columns review at the pre-specified tau_0, captured twice on the clean feat/columns-tau at dd62d5a (identical after normalization). For each SIMULATED demo of tools.mps_zquality_window.DEMO_CASES (viable, marginal, none): npz = batch_columns.write_simulated_input(<WORK>/sim_<name>.npz, *DEMO_CASES[name]); launcher = mcw.start_columns_review(zw.inputs_from_npz(npz), n_null=19); launcher.wait(); w = launcher.window; w.wait_viability(); default selection (selection_state().reset()); w.start_run(); wait until idle; record the fields of 'cases' (header_label, viability_label, results_text(), selection_counter_label text + isVisible, leak_banner.isVisible, warnings_list, simnull_button isEnabled + toolTip, export_tables(<WORK>/export_<name>/decisions.csv, duplicates='append'): the results row and header, the decision rows' sha256 (json.dumps(rows, sort_keys=True) of the rows read back with csv.DictReader), the exploration-log rows of the axon). MPS_SELECTION_LOG_DIR and every file in a temporary work folder. The windows are opened one after the other in one process (one session). Normalization: see 'normalization'. Simulated axons only: no path, no measured number.
normalization: '(run finished HH:MM:SS, S s,' and '(checked HH:MM:SS, S s;' replace the clock time and the seconds
the temporary work folder (both slash styles) -> '<WORK>' in every string
export rows: 'exported_at' and 'run_seconds' dropped; 'source' -> its basename
